vector_text_representation: outlined glyph paths; no external font dependency
diagram_A_scope: 専用方式は要約生成・採否判定・行動生成の順。行動併記方式は同じ応答で行動と候補を生成し，プログラム実行と結果記録の後，次の行動生成前に採否を決める。候補はその新しい実行結果を含まない。
panel_titles: 実験A：要約機会での呼出し順序
実験B：API実行記録に基づく終了制御
repetition_notation: The same repeat marker appears next to both recurrent methods; it denotes a later eligible opportunity, not repetition on every turn.
details_delegated_to_body: inline candidate does not contain the current response execution result
monochrome_encoding: Action calls: solid gray. Dedicated summary calls: hatched with dashed border. Harness steps: plain white. Inline action and candidate share one gray outer response box with no dedicated-summary hatching.
B_rule_scope: Handwritten completion check for the known request type: all target moves and name retention; complete API once when supported, otherwise continue.
recurrent_summary_input: Previous accepted summary plus newly eligible older unsummarized history; task and recent context remain intact.
initial_history_without_summary: Original history remains visible until a summary is accepted.
evaluator_scope: After the task run only; no answer flows into the running model.
